paragraphs.text: Field Mighty Clockwork  [Skill 1 • Tier 1 • DC 8 • Common]
Effect. Creates a Tiny or Small automaton (AC 12, 12 HP) able to perform one programmed task and make a basic force attack. It functions for 1 encounter before servicing.
Components. 4 × Springs; 1 × copper dragon fang
Work. 8 hours at Tinker's Workshop; tools: Tinker's tools, Precision drivers, Calibration gauge.
Yield and value. 5 item(s); recommended market value 78 gp.

useBinding.serviceUnit: First actual operation of this automaton in a genuine encounter spends one service unit and opens that encounter's paid operating block, lasting at most ten elapsed minutes from that operation. Mere encounter start does not debit a stored or otherwise unoperated automaton. Ordinary idleness before a block starts spends nothing and grants no active behavior. Continuing operation beyond a block's expiry needs another paid block; a distinct genuine encounter has its own service requirement. Preserve TI-05's transition from an operating noncombat block into a genuine encounter, its no-refund/no-clock-pause rules and its physical-identity history.

paragraphs.label: Effect and operation
paragraphs.text: Choose Tiny or Small before work and keep that size. The finished Construct has AC 12 and maximum 12 HP; full unmodified B5 chassis gives full HP, otherwise initial HP is max(1, floor(12 × latest chassis HP / 5)). Its fixed magical nonspell melee attack is +3 to hit, reach 5 feet, 1d6 force on hit, no ability damage or condition rider. Ordinary attack natural results apply. Tiny: STR 6, DEX 12, CON 10, INT 3, WIS 10, CHA 1, walk 20 feet, gripper load at most 5 lb. Small: STR 12, DEX 10, CON 12, INT 3, WIS 10, CHA 1, walk 25 feet, at most 20 lb. Ordinary senses/passive 10; no flight, PB, equipment slots or Anacite modules. Poison damage and Poisoned immunity only; other defenses are not inferred. Maximum service units 1: First actual operation of this automaton in a genuine encounter spends one service unit and opens that encounter's paid operating block, lasting at most ten elapsed minutes from that operation. Mere encounter start does not debit a stored or otherwise unoperated automaton. Ordinary idleness before a block starts spends nothing and grants no active behavior. Continuing operation beyond a block's expiry needs another paid block; a distinct genuine encounter has its own service requirement. Preserve TI-05's transition from an operating noncombat block into a genuine encounter, its no-refund/no-clock-pause rules and its physical-identity history. Outside encounters, first actual operation spends one service unit for one ten-elapsed-minute noncombat block. Continuing past expiry needs another; entering combat closes the noncombat block and spends a new unit. Zero units inside an already paid block permits that block only. Suppression/shutdown keeps the clock running. TI-04 binds a capable consenting INT-6+ controller with ten minutes of real tools/permission, at most three active ordinary crafted automata; class companion/deployable slots keep their separate source limits. One owner-wide Bonus Action command and one relevant offensive allowance per numbered round across class/crafted devices; actual communication within 60 feet, execution after the whole controller turn, no independent Reaction. The commanded creature moves and makes one attack or permitted task; powered uncommanded behavior is only defensive movement/Dodge. Transfer cannot give a second attack. Finite noncombat programming is ten minutes, with Action start and paid blocks; no professional crafting, script use or ram crew. At zero HP it is a destroyed recoverable wreck if original primaries survive; no death saves, Wounds or ordinary biological healing. TI-06 servicing and AC-09/TD-07 restoration are distinct. Structural quality never changes the printed creature statistics. TI-03–07 govern the complete procedure.

paragraphs.label: Routed Dissonance
paragraphs.text: Only the acquired TD-08 feature, once per genuine short rest, permits a Bonus Action to route up to two current Dissonance into one own active qualifying device within 30 feet. The routed disabled state prevents movement, attacks, auras, triggers and every other active device use. A routed trap cannot discharge, and a routed utility cannot provide its charged task benefit while disabled. Existing durations and paid service/winding clocks continue. Clearing the disable requires its existing specifically authorized completed removal procedure; it does not refill charges, service, RP or Refrain, erase expenditures, or grant a queued activation. An invalid blocked declaration spends nothing; a later disable does not refund a previously legal committed cost. Actual Field Repair, the existing ten-active-minute/1RP/Tinker's-tools procedure, the origin Tinker's next completed genuine short rest or completed qualifying ordinary repair may clear only the permitted functional state. A buyer's unrelated rest does not clear it.

paragraphs.label: Complete output bodies
paragraphs.text: Choose before any work: TI-auto-tiny: Mundane pre-animation Tiny chassis; finished creature uses source AC/HP, not this stock HP/AC. 25 gp, 8 lb, ordinary B5, structural AC 19, dimensions 12 × 8 × 8 inches; TI-auto-small: Mundane pre-animation Small chassis; finished creature uses source AC/HP, not this stock HP/AC. 50 gp, 25 lb, ordinary B5, structural AC 19, dimensions 24 × 16 × 20 inches. See the complete body catalogue for original primaries, constituent masses, hands, capacity and support. A creature output replaces stock object HP/AC with its printed creature statistics. EN alternate weapon/suit hosts use their exact registered existing equipment profile; these default figures do not overwrite that alternate body.

paragraphs.text: Reserve 7 actual complete never-magically-altered bodies, one model/size per order, in an exclusive fixed order. All must be complete and positive-HP immediately before the completion roll, even if fewer outputs will result. Bodies are additional to the exact source batch components and working tools. Pre-roll lawful replacement keeps its ordered position; no post-roll acquisition, substitution or reordering. Transform the first resolved outputs; unused bodies remain actual mundane stock. Use unmodified, unflawed B5 chassis; a former creature/class device is not a blank. Record material identity, condition, real storage, actual station capacity, preservation and safe handling; a quoted price supplies none of those facts.
